protocol: NASA JSC EA1. Eleven-day chamber checkout with 48-hour acclimation and five scheduled six-hour simulated EVAs. The later pressure traces support a nominal 4.3 psia plateau. Twenty-minute prebreathe at 85% oxygen.
outcome_window: Repeated in-chamber measurements across the five scheduled EVAs. Sleep or post-chamber VGE surveillance is unreported.
locator: Author abstract, Methods and Results and Discussion
note: The authors report VGE in three of the six volunteers across repeated EVAs. No person-EVA count or modality-specific numerator is supplied. The report does not identify the positive participants, link VGE to clinical DCS or specify delayed follow-up.
